Definition: from the base of G837; healthy, i.e. well (in body); figuratively, true (in doctrine):--sound, whole.
BiblicalUsage: hygiḗs means sound, healthy, whole. In Matthew 12:13, the text says "and it was restored whole." In Mark 5:34, the text says "thy faith hath made thee whole."
TheologicalSignificance: For me, hygiḗs is a reminder that healing is God's work, in His time and His way, and He is able. That shapes how I read the passages where it appears: not as filler, but as God's own wording for what He is doing.
RelatedEvents: Jairus' Daughter and the Bleeding Woman; The Healing at the Pool of Bethesda; Jesus Heals a Man with a Withered Hand
